summary: Add aggregate performance metrics, an analysis percentage and estimated finish time, user-selectable 1/2/4 local document workers, selective whole-page vision routing, exact-evidence-scope semantic-verification batching, and a user-configurable project budget limit. Paid model requests stay serial and all prior reservation, unknown-charge, retry, and reconciliation safeguards remain active.
decision_refs: User-selected P0/P1 optimization list and explicit budget-unlock approval on 2026-09-15
approval_evidence: The user selected the four performance priorities and explicitly allowed the fixed project budget to be unlocked for a user-defined range.
known_limitations: Local concurrency is across documents; one large PDF is not split across parser workers.
Paid text and vision requests remain serial to preserve deterministic ledger and provider-rate behavior.
Aggregate timing is diagnostic and has no live speedup or construction-accuracy benchmark in this change.
Selective vision still uses eligible full-page images; local high-resolution crop routing remains planned.
